question: In July 2025, Indian government launched "SOAR" initiative. This initiative targets______
solution:
The correct answer is __**AI-skilling grades 6–12 school students**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **SOAR initiative**, launched by the Indian Government in **July 2025**, focuses on **AI-skilling students** from grades **6 to 12**, aiming to prepare the younger generation for the **future workforce driven by Artificial Intelligence (AI)**. 
• It specifically targets **school students aged between 11–18 years** to ensure early exposure to AI technologies and applications, fostering **innovation, creativity, and problem-solving skills**. 
• The initiative is part of India’s larger strategy to **strengthen its position as a global AI hub**, ensuring that the youth are equipped with **cutting-edge technological knowledge**. 
• The program includes **AI-specific training modules**, **hands-on workshops**, and **real-world problem-solving exercises**, making AI concepts accessible and practical for school-aged learners. 
• **Implementation partners** for this initiative include **leading tech companies**, educational institutions, and **government bodies**, ensuring a robust and scalable framework for AI skill development. <
